classification.difficultyReason: Identify the shorter diagonal and apply the cosine rule in the relevant triangle.

content.prompt: $ABCD$ is a parallelogram with sides 15 cm and 18 cm. The angle at $A$ is $65^\circ$. Find the length of the shorter diagonal, correct to two decimal places.

spec.description: Parallelogram ABCD with diagonal DB, 18 cm on AB, 15 cm on AD, and matching single and double parallel-arrow markings.
spec.mathematics: Adjacent sides enclose angle A of 65 degrees, supplied in the prompt.

answer.worked:
Since $\angle A=65^\circ$ is acute, $BD$ is the shorter diagonal. In $\triangle ABD$:
$$\begin{align*}BD^2&=15^2+18^2-2\times15\times18\cos65^\circ\\BD&=\sqrt{15^2+18^2-2\times15\times18\cos65^\circ}\\BD&\approx17.91\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
